propositions: Within a single _run_opengrep invocation, semgrep --validate is invoked exactly once per unique detector source_path (11 detectors from 5 YAML files reduced from 11 validation calls to 5)
A shared source that fails validation quarantines every detector from that source as invalid_detector with per-detector detail preserved
Call-local source-path-keyed cache is implemented inside _run_opengrep with no persistent, module-level, or cross-scan state introduced

Scan execution, SARIF normalization, and coverage record behavior remain unchanged; existing test suites (test_engine_b.py, test_conformance.py, test_coverage_reconstruction.py) pass without modification
Median measured improvement from validation-only deduplication is 26.025s → 14.135s (11.89s saved per two-call pair), reducing validation subprocesses from 22 to 10
